correctness.rationale: For smooth complex λ≠±2, computed the homogeneous Hessian symbolically and independently verified its exact factor 6272 X²Y²Z^6[6λ(X^8+Y^8)+(28−λ²)X^4Y^4]. This proves the complete flex divisor 6B+2A+div_C R. Residual quadratic in u=(X/Y)^4 has discriminant (λ²−4)(λ²−196), independently checked symbolic factorization; reduction mod branch polynomial is 7(4−λ²)u, ensuring disjointness off singular λ. Hence generic 8 contact-eight+16 contact-four+64 simple flex, λ±14 8+48 contact-four, λ0 24 contact-eight; weighted total 144. For real λ>-2 Q>0 and real locus empty; λ<-2 exactly two x-sign intervals with two glued z-branches each give two ovals, four real branch flexes; residual R strictly negative on u>=0. All parameter boundaries accounted. No positive-characteristic or singular-pencil claim.
